sources.tmax: NOAA NCEI GHCN-D station mean (data/cache/<fid>/ncei.parquet); NASA POWER T2M_MAX where no station reports
sources.eto: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (backend/engine weather.pm_eto): station Tmax/Tmin, POWER ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, WS2M, RH2M; elevation 106.13 m, latitude 36.038
sources.imerg: NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily (Final, Late after 2025-09-30), backend/nasa imerg.parquet
sources.smap_pct: NASA SMAP L4 SPL4SMGP.008 sm_rootzone_pctl (backend/nasa smap_l4.parquet); GRACE-DA GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D rtzsm_inst percentile where SMAP is missing
sources.ndvi_modis: MOD13Q1.061 NDVI at the field centroid (missing), good/marginal pixels
sources.ndvi_hls: field-median NDVI, S2 L2A (backend/field) first, then HLS (backend/nasa, nasa_open), then Landsat C2 L2
sources.water: S2/Landsat NDWI > 0.3 or SCL water > 50% on the field, or OPERA DSWx-HLS water >= 50% of the clear field
sources.lst: ECOSTRESS ECO_L2T_LSTE.002 (backend/nasa) where cached, else MODIS MOD11A2.061 LST_Day_1km (Planetary Computer)
sources.esi: ECOSTRESS ECO_L4T_ESI.002 where cached; else ECOSTRESS ECO_L3T_JET ETdaily / Penman-Monteith ETo (same ratio as ESI, AppEEARS bundle in data/cache/_appeears); else OpenET Ensemble monthly ET / Penman-Monteith ETo
sources.usdm: US Drought Monitor county statistics, cumulative % area in D3-D4 (data/cache/<fid>/usdm*.parquet)
